verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is not itself an agent, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and this axis applies. The evidence covers only sign-in, OTP, passkeys, backup and Verified ID features, and nothing mentions an MCP server or agent connectivity. The probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs or OpenAPI spec either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
